title: Keep factual coverage separate from review approval
preconditions: Use isolated comparisons with complete coverage and with an uncovered line; no review approval has been recorded.

steps.action: Read status --json and status text for each comparison, and inspect query overview coverage.
steps.expected_result: Output reports coverage facts, completeness and gaps without claiming the change is approved.

steps.action: Query review state before and after the coverage reads.
steps.expected_result: Coverage reads do not create an approval or reviewer decision.

expected_result: Complete coverage conveys no approval verdict.
